tip.title: Use tonight's Russian block for ship-day phrases

ottoman.summary: From 1774 on, Ottoman rulers faced Russian and European pressure, but decline alone does not describe an age of reform, new institutions, and expanding state power. Mahmud II destroyed the Janissaries, the Tanzimat remade law and administration, and railways and foreign debt brought both capacity and outside leverage inside the empire. National movements and great-power settlements peeled away Balkan territories even as the state kept reforming and fighting.

surprise.title: FORTRAN turns 70 today
surprise.body: On this date in 1956, FORTRAN — widely remembered as the first modern high-level programming language — was first shared with the coding community. John Backus led the IBM team that built it so scientists could write math instead of raw machine code. Seventy years later, that same idea still sits under almost every language you will meet while studying for CompTIA A+.
